query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(EXPR0), 0), T2 FROM (SELECT t5.T2, COUNT(CASE WHEN EMP1.DEPTNO = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS EXPR0 FROM EMP AS EMP1, (VALUES (1)) AS t5 (T2) GROUP BY t5.T2 UNION ALL SELECT t8.T2, COUNT(CASE WHEN EMP2.DEPTNO = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS EXPR0 FROM EMP AS EMP2, (VALUES (2)) AS t8 (T2) GROUP BY t8.T2) AS t11 GROUP BY T2
select empno, sum(sal), min(sal), max(sal),  bit_and(distinct sal), bit_or(sal), count(distinct sal),  grouping(deptno) from emp group by empno, deptno
